rules.storms: Every storm in timeline.json's storms, in the same order (index i here is index i there); id is the IBTrACS storm id (SID).
rules.points: Every IBTrACS v04r01 best-track row of the storm (about 3-hourly; agency fixes at other hours kept) whose position falls inside the map window, plus the row just before and just after each stretch inside, so the line reaches the map edge. Positions are projected to map units; times are UTC. Points are not simplified.
rules.wind: kt from one agency per storm, the rule of the Typhoons lens: JMA's 10-minute wind (TOKYO_WIND, else WMO_WIND) if JMA estimated the storm anywhere on its track, else JTWC's 1-minute wind (USA_WIND). null where that agency gives no wind at that row.
